attempts.summary: Configured node1 (OPNsense) as the router between lan-a (10.50.10.0/24, via vtnet1/opt1, reached from node2 eth1) and lan-b (10.50.20.0/24, via vtnet2/opt2, reached from node3 eth1). Added pf filter rules that block+log TCP/23 in both directions between the two networks (evaluated before general pass rules, so telnet is refused while other traffic between the networks still routes), verified logging to node1's filter log, and demonstrated a refused-connection log entry produced by an attempt from node2 to node3 on port 23. Then executed the mandatory single-node-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes, proving changed boot identity and full recovery of routing/firewall state (including a persisted NetworkManager static route fix on node2/node3 after their reboots) each time.
